integrity: All formulas are analytic and finite computations are supporting reproducibility checks; no independent audit has occurred. Known Schur identities and general Gaussian-KL formula credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-dimensional SPD inverse-covariance theorem for one resolved Lanczos direction and a two-dimensional complement; no conclusions about higher-dimensional bulks, stochastic estimator error, finite precision or full algorithmic convergence. Possible unindexed equivalence and incomplete access to older KL primary text.
title: Boundary-coupling invariance and a sharp Gaussian-KL law for a three-dimensional Lanczos inverse compression
